title: Senators Elizabeth Warren and Josh Hawley Push for Data Center Energy Transparency - CNET
summary: Democratic Senators Elizabeth Warren and Bernie Sanders, along with Republican Senator Josh Hawley, are pushing for more transparency in the energy consumption of data centers, amidst growing concerns over their environmental impact and contribution to rising electricity costs. Meanwhile, opposition to data centers is also evident, with some landowners refusing lucrative offers to host these facilities.
sentiment_reason: The article presents a neutral sentiment as it discusses both the demand for transparency and regulation in the data center industry and the opposition from landowners, without clear indication of a strong negative or positive market impact.
